title: scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs fails on develop: normalizeSiteBrandId('pilobol') contract mismatch
description:
Pre-existing failure on develop, NOT introduced by any current branch. Verified by running it on an untouched develop checkout.

scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs line 33 asserts normalizeSiteBrandId('pilobol') === null, but lib/site-brand.ts maps 'pilobol' -> 'pilobol-us'. One side is wrong and it is a one-line decision about which: either the alias is intended (fix the test) or it is not (fix the mapping).

CONSEQUENCE: because node:assert aborts on first failure, nothing after line 33 in that file ever runs. The author of Papyrus PR #83 therefore put new anth-us brand assertions in a sibling scripts/test-anth-us-brand.cjs (+ npm run test:anth-us-brand) rather than appending to a file that never reaches them. Worth consolidating once this is resolved.
